Package com.ucm.server.logic

Class Game

java.lang.Object
com.ucm.server.logic.Game
public class Game extends Object
Represents a poker game instance with all necessary components and logic. It handles the game flow, including player management, card dealing, betting rounds, and determining winners. The class also manages the game history and supports dynamic blind adjustments based on the game configuration.

  • Field Details

    • DEBUG

      public static final boolean DEBUG
      Flag to keep the game in debug mode, enabling additional logging and diagnostic information. This can be useful for development and troubleshooting purposes, allowing developers to trace the flow of the game and identify issues more easily.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • MAX_CARDS_IN_TABLE

      public static final int MAX_CARDS_IN_TABLE
      Maximum number of cards that can be placed on the table during a poker game. In Texas Hold'em, this is typically 5 cards (the flop, turn, and river).

  • Constructor Details

    • Game

      public Game(List<com.ucm.common.ClientStruct> players, List<com.ucm.common.BotStruct> bots, Spectator spectator, com.ucm.common.GameConfig config) throws EvaluatorException
      Constructs a new Game instance with the specified players, bots, spectator, evaluator and game configuration.
      Parameters:
      players - List of players to join in the game
      bots - List of bots to join in the game
      spectator - Spectator to join in the game. This can be null if there is no spectator.
      config - Game configuration settings for the game, including blinds, initial money, and other parameters.
      Throws:
      EvaluatorException - if there is an error initializing the poker hand evaluator.

    • playHand

      public void playHand() throws com.ucm.common.exceptions.OnlyOnePlayerLeftException, com.ucm.common.exceptions.CancelGameException
      Plays a hand of poker, managing the game flow through the different streets (pre-flop, flop, turn, river). It handles the betting rounds, card dealing, and updates the game history accordingly. This also manages the dynamic blind increases if enabled in the game configuration and the history of the game.
      Throws:
      com.ucm.common.exceptions.OnlyOnePlayerLeftException - if all players except one have folded, indicating that the hand has ended prematurely.
      com.ucm.common.exceptions.CancelGameException - if there is an error during the hand play process, such as issues with player actions or game state management.

    • showdown

      public void showdown() throws com.ucm.common.exceptions.CancelGameException
      Handles the showdown phase of the poker game, where players reveal their hands and the winner is determined. Delegates the calculation of the hand winner, distribution of the prize, and management of eliminated players. This also updates the game history and waits for a specified duration to allow players to view the winner before proceeding.
      Throws:
      com.ucm.common.exceptions.CancelGameException - if there is an error during the showdown process, such as issues with hand evaluation or prize distribution.
      See Also:
      • for the actual implementation of prize distribution.
      • for the actual implementation of managing eliminated players.

    • passTurn

      public boolean passTurn() throws com.ucm.common.exceptions.CancelGameException
      Delegates the passing of the turn to the next player in the game, managing the transition between betting rounds and updating the game state accordingly. It also handles the end of the game if all players have completed their actions, and resets the game state for the next round if the game continues.
      Returns:
      true if the game has ended, false if the game continues to the next round.
      Throws:
      com.ucm.common.exceptions.CancelGameException - if there is an error during the turn passing process, such as issues with player actions or game state management.
      See Also:
      • for the actual implementation of checking if the game has ended.
      • for the actual implementation of notifying players about the end of the game.
      • for the actual implementation of passing the turn to the next player.

    • updateEquity

      public void updateEquity() throws com.ucm.common.exceptions.CancelGameException
      Updates the equity for all players in the game based on their current hands and the community cards on the table. It calculates the equity using the EquityCalculator and notifies each player of their respective equity
      Throws:
      com.ucm.common.exceptions.CancelGameException - if there is an error during the equity calculation process, such as issues with player hands or game state management.
      See Also:
      • for the actual implementation of equity calculation.
      • for the actual implementation of notifying players about their equity.
